title: “Contact may have already taken place on a different plane of awareness”
content: I usually try to keep ufo/phenomenon/conspiracy stuff to a minimum on here but I think this is very relevant if it’s real. I’d love to see if anyone can verify whether this was an actual book that the government really used or not. Starting at about 1:59:50 is the interesting part. The title of the book is allegedly “Introductory Space Science volume II. Link to the podcast: https://open.spotify.com/episode/04gQ8km0XhEitU1Vz4lA3j?si=mp9pE4KjTHqSDkobVbxziA&t=7190
